links.title: Correct way to do a "teardrop" pattern entry
links.description: 1. Fly 90 degrees perpendicular to the runway at 500 ft above the highest pattern altitude (jets already fly 500 above regular, so that's 1,000 above regular pattern altitude for us). 2. Cross midfield, fly out 1 mile, then descend to pattern altitude on the same heading. 3. Once at pattern altitude, make a turn (right, if it's a left downwind) to enter on a 45 to the downwind while announcing your position.
